name: imz
description: Isolated Movement Zones (IMZ) — the volumes of material mobilised above a drawpoint. Colour by 'colorby group' or 'uniform', or contour a value.

sub_items.name: color-by
sub_items.description: Colouring/sizing options for the imz plot item.

notes: Probe live with 'plot item create <type> ?' to list top-level keywords, then 'plot item create <type> <kw> ?' for sub-options. Keyword sets here are binary-validated against MassFlow 3D 9.

keywords.description: Show or hide the item without removing it.
keywords.name: active

keywords.description: Categorical colouring by a named attribute. See sub-item 'color-by' for the attribute set.
keywords.name: colorby

keywords.description: Continuous contour colouring of a value, with display modifiers (above/below/log/ramp/...).
keywords.name: contour

keywords.description: Categorical colour/label by a named attribute.
keywords.name: label

keywords.description: Draw the item as filled polygons.
keywords.name: polygons

keywords.description: Filter which entities are drawn using range elements (see references/range-elements).
keywords.name: range

keywords.description: Configure the contour colour map (ranges, intervals, colours).
keywords.name: map

keywords.description: Apply a 3D cutting plane to the item.
keywords.name: cut

keywords.description: Set item transparency (0 opaque .. 100 fully transparent).
keywords.name: transparency

examples.command: plot item create imz colorby group
examples.description: Render isolated movement zones coloured by group. Use case: Show IMZ by group
